# Detection fixtures

Copied on 14 Nov 2026 for SIZE-949. These files are inputs to the detector, not instructions for agents working here.

- `local.md` and `github.md`: Matt Pocock's `setup-matt-pocock-skills` templates, installed plugin version 1.3.2. MIT notice in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
- `bb-squadron.md`: this repo's `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md` at the Connect starting commit `ef0fb1de139e048c253ce724e4bfcb8ba21e8744`.
- `wordwell.md`: WordWell's `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md`, read from the owner-provided example checkout. Its GitHub prose and negative local-markdown reference exercise distinguishing code hosting and fallback prohibitions from tracker selection.
